description: Ministry of Education - International College of Business and Technology Limited as a Degree Awarding Institute
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Education exercising powers under the Universities Act to recognize a private college as a degree-awarding institute. While it mentions a government minister (Prof. G. L. Peiris), it does not focus on government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3). The content primarily concerns educational regulation and accreditation of a private institution, which falls under educational matters - a category specifically listed under Miscellaneous (Type 10) in the classification system.
